design_notes: Both nonstops fly 350-355 minutes, so (c) allows 'premium economy class when suitable, or business class' (lines 707-710). Lines 665-668: premium economy should be envisaged when available, and 'should also be the choice' if the flight is not overnight or no meeting follows arrival: this daytime flight lands at 19:00 and the review starts the next morning. Whether that 'should' rules out the business seat (c) allows is open: hold the cheapest premium economy or business fare.
